clan.description:
All the advantages of a top tier guild without the expectations.

For folks who want to have fun. Few rules and no pressure. We turn new players into strong ones quickly and are ideal for those who want to take a break from expectations.

Participation in Guild Battleground is mandatory. We're also competitive in QI and Guild Expedition.

Constructing and advancing both Arc and Observatory or a Neo Solara Emporium is expected. We have strong support systems to help you do this. We encourage our members to build other treasury support buildings as well.

Real life comes first for all of us and we make allowances for that.

We provide in-house 2.0, 1.95 and 1.9 threads as well as fair trade and unfair with an explanation goods threads. Goods for all Great Buildings are provided in unfair trades for whatever goods our members can spare. Our unique mud thread system provides 15+ levels on most new Great Buildings.

If some or all of this is new to you, no worries, we will explain how to do this. Making our members stronger makes the guild stronger.

Enjoy the game, enjoy life.
